correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact destination draws on each side of non-lazy K_(n,n) are iid uniform, so split/same CDFs at even N=2k are F(1,N)^2 and F(2,N)F(0,N); odd CDFs are F(1,N+1)^2 and F(2,N)F(0,N+2). In terms of surjection counts a_(N,j)=j!S(N,j), even difference is [a_(N,n-1)^2-a_(N,n-2)*a_(N,n)]/n^(2N). The sequence is strictly log-concave on positive support by a_(N+1,j)=j(a_(N,j)+a_(N,j-1)), and positivity begins exactly N>=n-1. First-draw identities show the odd difference is positive exactly N>=n-2. Same-vertex start is pathwise dominated by two distinct same-side seeds. Independently recomputed exact coupon recurrences for n=2..10, k=0..12 (234 comparisons) and the n=2 t=1,2 values; finite tests corroborate the self-contained all-n proof.
